description: This file defines the interface for an MQTT-SN client library, including enums, data structures, macros, and function prototypes for initializing, connecting, subscribing, publishing, and handling MQTT-SN protocol operations.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_client_init
methods.description: Initializes an MQTT-SN client with specified parameters.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_deinit
methods.description: Deinitializes the MQTT-SN client, freeing resources.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection for the MQTT-SN client, optionally with a will message.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_sleep
methods.description: Puts the MQTT-SN client into sleep mode for a specified duration.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the client to a specified topic with a given QoS.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes the client from a specified topic.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_publish
methods.description: Publishes data to a specified topic with given QoS and retain flag.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_input
methods.description: Checks the transport for incoming data and processes it.

methods.name: mqtt_sn_get_topic_name
methods.description: Retrieves the topic name associated with a given topic ID.
